implementation: Todo 2 phase 2 — fix three bugs: AUTORAG_SEARCH_PATHS path, malformed fingerprint blocking, stale lock recovery

bugfixes.bug1: AUTORAG_SEARCH_PATHS now points to <shared-root>/corpus (immutable bootstrapped), not .autorag-e2e/search-paths (mutable scratch)
bugfixes.bug2: loadFingerprint() throws on malformed/empty files; cmdPrintEnv catches and exits 1 with live-e2e-fingerprint-mismatch
bugfixes.bug3: tryLock() now calls breakStaleLock() before each mkdir attempt, detecting dead PIDs via kill(pid,0). Stale locks without PID are conservatively held (not broken), preventing <1ms mkdir→PID-write race. SIGKILL'd holders are detected and broken.

addedTests: AUTORAG_SEARCH_PATHS is an existing directory with MANIFEST.json
malformed JSON in fingerprint/state.json blocks warm mode
empty file in fingerprint/state.json blocks warm mode
cold mode overwrites malformed fingerprint silently
stale lock with dead PID broken and acquired
stale lock dead PID broken after acquire (idempotent)
lock without PID file is conservatively treated as held
live holder lock is held; SIGKILL then followed by acquire

diagnostics.nodeCheck: exit=0 on all .mjs files (env.mjs, bootstrap.mjs, runner.mjs)

malformed_fingerprint_json.result: Warm mode: exit 1 with live-e2e-fingerprint-mismatch; cold mode: exit 0 (wipes and rebuilds)

stale_lock_with_dead_pid.result: Dead PID: breakStaleLock detects via kill(pid,0), removes lock, next mkdir succeeds. No PID: conservative 'held' to avoid mkdir→write race. SIGKILL: detect dead, break, acquire.

concurrent_lock_with_pid_race.result: Exactly one acquires. breakStaleLock without PID does not break (conservative), avoiding the mkdir→write race.

cross_test_isolation.result: beforeAll/afterAll cleanup at file level prevents cross-file pollution. Tests consolidated into single file.

postWriteReview.singleResponsibility: env.mjs: environment/fingerprint/lock/cleanup; runner.mjs: CLI dispatch; bootstrap.mjs: corpus bootstrap/verify.
postWriteReview.boundaryPurity: CLI args parsed at boundary. Fingerprint parsed at boundary, throws on malformed. Lock PID checked via OS process table.
postWriteReview.variantDiscrimination: tryLock returns discriminated union; cmdLockProbe switches on kind exhaustively.
postWriteReview.defensiveLayer: None. breakStaleLock conservative on missing PID avoids TOCTOU race.
postWriteReview.tests: 24 focused tests in single file (plus 11 preserved).
postWriteReview.pureLOC: env.mjs <250, runner.mjs <250, test file <500 (combined from two files). All clean.
